bfs: BFS stands for Breadth First Search. It explores nodes level by level using a queue.
dfs: DFS stands for Depth First Search. It explores deeply before backtracking using a stack.
astar: A* search uses path cost plus heuristic value to find optimal paths.
ucs: Uniform Cost Search expands the node with minimum path cost.
csp: Constraint Satisfaction Problems solve variables under constraints using backtracking.
bayesian: Bayesian Networks represent probabilistic relationships between variables.
minimax: Minimax is used in game playing AI to maximize winning chances.
alpha beta: Alpha Beta pruning reduces unnecessary minimax calculations.
